note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on TLS vs mutual TLS, certificate-based trust for the JWT Bearer flow, Salesforce's inbound mutual-authentication certificate feature, and the self-signed-certificate pitfall. Taught through narrative and a short written scenario, no screenshots, per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. Sources disagreed on whether Salesforce accepts self-signed certificates for outbound two-way SSL (one third-party connector guide said yes for a legacy feature, another said a different connector's server rejects them) -- the guide deliberately hedges this as feature-dependent rather than asserting one universal rule, and recommends verifying against the specific feature's current docs.
